claims.text: Alila Ubud sits on a hillside above the Ayung River, surrounded by jungle canopy.

findings.quote: Perched above the sacred Ayung River, Alila Ubud offers a secluded hillside retreat surrounded by jungle canopy and calming stillness.
findings.note: Hillside location above the Ayung River and jungle canopy are both stated.

claims.text: The resort blends contemporary design with traditional Balinese architecture.

findings.quote: Blending contemporary design with traditional Balinese architecture

claims.text: The rooms and villas overlook the Ayung River Valley and are designed to resemble a Balinese village.

findings.quote: Overlooking the rolling hills of the Ayung River Valley, Alila Ubud’s 56 rooms and 18 villas offer a secluded retreat, designed to resemble a Balinese village.
findings.note: Both the valley outlook and the village-style design are stated.

findings.quote: Overlooking the rolling hills of the Ayung River Valley, the 56 rooms and 18 Villas of Alila Ubud offer a secluded retreat, designed to resemble a Balinese village.
findings.note: The rooms page says the same.

claims.text: Lower-floor rooms have individual garden terraces, and high-floor rooms have spacious balconies with jungle views.

findings.quote: Revel in individual garden terraces in all of the lower-floor rooms, and spacious balconies with jungle views in the high-floor rooms.

claims.text: Deluxe rooms have a private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and garden and valley views.

findings.quote: Enjoy this 700-square-foot room, which comes with one king bed, private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and sweeping garden and valley views.
Step inside this 700-square-foot room, featuring two twin beds, private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and sweeping garden and valley views.

claims.text: The Pool Villa has a private pool and an open-air tub among lotus, and includes in-villa check-in and check-out.

findings.quote: Enjoy in a secluded 120-sqm villa with a private pool, surrounded by gardens and trees. Relax in an open-air tub among lotus, or on terrace daybeds. Includes swift in-villa check-in/out.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Villa is the resort's largest, with a private pool, outdoor tubs and a separate dining area.

findings.quote: At 240 square metres, our Two Bedroom Villa is the resort’s largest and features a private pool, outdoor tubs and a separate dining area.
the Two Bedroom Villa is the resort’s largest, with a private pool, outdoor tubs, and a separate dining area.

claims.text: Spa Alila combines contemporary wellness products and services with ancient Asian healing techniques.

findings.quote: At Spa Alila, we combine contemporary wellness products and services with ancient Asian healing techniques and age-old beauty recipes.

claims.text: A weekly wellness program includes sunrise yoga, Qi Gong and Tai Chi.

findings.quote: During our weekly wellness ritual, begin with sunrise yoga, where body and spirit align with the first light of day, or discover the flowing grace of Qi Gong and Tai Chi
findings.note: All three activities are named as part of the weekly ritual.

claims.text: Guests can craft their own silver piece side by side with local Balinese artisans, or work alongside a farmer in the rice fields.

findings.quote: Gain a newfound appreciation for the work of silversmiths as you forge bonds—literally and figuratively—with local artisans while you work side-by-side to craft your own piece of wearable art.
findings.note: Covers the silver-crafting experience; the experience is titled 'Crafting Silver with a Balinese Artisan'.

findings.quote: Experience the joy, rhythm, and beauty of bringing rice to the table as you work with a farmer to cultivate this most precious nutrient.
try your hand at planting rice with a local guide
findings.note: Confirms the hands-on work in the rice fields.

claims.text: Plantation Restaurant serves Asian specialties in a Balinese wantilan-style pavilion with an alang-alang roof, overlooking the Ayung River valley.

findings.quote: Delight in the refined flavors of Plantation Restaurant, where curated Asian specialties celebrate seasonal ingredients
Dine beneath an airy Balinese wantilan-style pavilion, framed by soaring coconut pillars and a traditional alang-alang roof, as the Ayung River valley provides a captivating backdrop
findings.note: Covers the pavilion, the roof and the valley setting.

claims.text: The Terrace Tree Villa is a treehouse-like retreat atop the valley, with a terrace looking over the rainforest canopy.

findings.quote: Stay in a 90-sqm Terrace Tree Villa, a treehouse-like retreat atop the valley. Enjoy sunrises over banyan and coconut trees. Relax on a terrace with the rainforest canopy view.

claims.text: The Valley Villa has valley views, an outdoor tub in a lotus pond and alang-alang roofing.

findings.quote: Enjoy breathtaking valley views, an outdoor tub in a lotus pond, and the comfort of alang-alang roofing.

claims.text: The resort has an infinity pool set among lush greenery.

findings.quote: Swim laps or lounge at our 25-metre infinity pool, nestled among the hotel property’s lush greenery and surrounded by luxurious sunbeds.

claims.text: On the Journey Through Purification and Prayer, a Balinese high priest pours blessed water over guests during the Melukat blessing.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in the spiritual traditions of Bali with a visit to the Brahmin compound of a Balinese high priest in the quiet surroundings of Ubud.
During the Melukat blessing, the priest pours blessed water over you—a simple yet powerful act meant to clear the mind and restore balance.
findings.note: Establishes the blessed-water pouring during the Melukat blessing.

claims.text: Spa Alila offers the lulur body scrub, an ancient village remedy that originates from Bali rice farmers.

findings.quote: Choose from locally inspired treatments like the lulur body scrub—an ancient village remedy that originates from Bali rice farmers

claims.text: The resort sits outside Ubud town rather than in its center; travel time depends on traffic.

findings.quote: The hotel is around 30 minutes from central Ubud, although the journey can take longer depending on traffic.
findings.note: A guest review establishes both the location outside the centre and the traffic dependence.

findings.quote: The hotel provides complimentary shuttle service into central Ubud.
findings.note: Implies the resort is outside the town centre.

claims.text: The resort is about 40 kilometers from I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport.

findings.quote: I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)40.3 kilometers

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and dining options in the immediate vicinity.
